versions.changelog:
- Added YAML front matter with skill name and description to SKILL.md for improved metadata and discoverability.
- No other changes to functionality or documentation content.

Initial release of the Repository Discovery Agent.

- Provides a comprehensive agent workflow for exploring and documenting unfamiliar GitHub repositories.
- Defines clear objectives: identify purpose, technology stack, dependencies, architecture, features, and developer instructions.
- Outlines a step-by-step process, from reading agent instructions to mapping project structure and workflow.
- Specifies REPO_DISCOVERY.md as the structured output format to brief future developers or agents.
- Emphasizes evidence-based documentation and guidance for maximizing developer onboarding value.
